title: First-person tools: variations
desc: Three new variations of each 803 tool take J rated IMPROVE (axe, sword chop, sweeps, thrust, combos, pickaxe, shovel, hammers), each with a different swing and a different way the construct forms; 120 degree first person with a crosshair, ring on the punching face.

takes.name: Axe: straight overhead chop, bite, wrench free
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; axe head fixed in the fist, edge leads into the chop; target knocked back on contact; hit tick 7; swing 13 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; forms as a pixel stream from the ring (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Axe: two chops into one notch
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; axe head fixed in the fist, edge leads into both chops; target knocked back on contact; hits ticks 6, 13; swing 18 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; extrudes out of the fist behind a scan plate (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Axe: level felling swing
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; rests in the 45 deg forward hold (head tipped toward the crosshair, edge forward) before, between and after the chop; hit tick 9; swing 14 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; sections fly in and lock on (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword combo: slow rising cross, chop, thrust
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; arm pulled in toward the crosshair, slower rising cross up to the right; target knocked back on contact; hits ticks 7, 14, 22; swing 26 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; forms as a pixel stream from the ring (ticks 0-14)
